'''Dengler/Zylan Inc.''' was a corporation during the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They were responsible for manufacturing the [[Zero-G Assault Stormtrooper Armor Mark I]] as well as the related [[Zero-G Utility Rig]] for the Empire.<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>
